nodes.title: Case Study: HT
nodes.reading:
Changing the person so the organization can see what it could not — the perspective engine behind JUBAP.

Within the Nueva Perspectiva philosophy · Stewarded by The Integral Management Society / IMSV.org

A company changes when the people inside it can see and do what they could not before. That is why our organizational work is paired with a discipline of human transformation — and why both live inside the same philosophy: Nueva Perspectiva .

Mindfulness is often what people notice first, but it is only one instrument. Human transformation is the broader practice: transpersonal coaching, experiential work, deep personal retreats, emotional intelligence and conscious attention — chosen and combined for the situation. The aim is never a pleasant experience that fades. It is a genuine change of perspective that lets a person locate their own blockages, see new options, and act.

JUBAP is Nueva Perspectiva put to work. The framework moves in two directions — and human transformation powers one of them.

nodes.title: Case Study: AICM
nodes.reading:
A bottom-up transformation that turned a workforce facing extinction into the reason the airport was kept, reformed and grown.

Enterprise transformation through JUBAP · Stewarded by The Integral Management Society / IMSV.org

The client was the Mexico City International Airport (AICM) — the largest airport in Latin America, handling 44M+ passengers a year, and at the time one of the most punctual in the world.

The intervention landed in one of the most sensitive episodes in recent Mexican infrastructure. The New Mexico City International Airport (NAICM) , a megaproject valued at roughly USD 13 billion , was already escalating in cost and tangled in governance tension and political instability.

That produced two crises at once. A national strategic problem : how to keep and modernize the country’s air infrastructure while the new airport’s future stayed unresolved. And a deep human problem : more than a thousand highly experienced, largely unionized airport workers — one of the largest concentrations of operational airport expertise in Mexico — faced redundancy, displacement or irrelevance, precisely when the country still depended on them. The engagement came shortly after the company’s work in another politically exposed national programme, the Chicontepec energy megaproject.

edges.reading: Esta pieza abre la lectura desde su documento de origen.
Desde «JubAp.EU», el enlace «Last articles» abre «Field Notes».

For a complementary reading, see [Human transformation: the perspective engine](https://jubap.eu/human-transformation/).
For a complementary reading, see [The AICM transformation programme](https://jubap.eu/aicm-mexico-city-airport-transformation/).
The Nestlé account describes how the dashboard, liberation strategy and six-domain root-cause tool were used as a sequence.
The AICM programme explicitly describes an adapted JUBAP route; the human-transformation article explains the perspective mechanism without establishing that every technique was used there.
For a complementary reading, see [Nestlé: where the framework was named](https://jubap.eu/nestle-case-study-where-jubap-was-first-named/).
For a complementary reading, see [The JUBAP adaptive transformation framework](https://jubap.eu/the-jubap-framework/).
For a complementary reading, see [Strategic reframing of an existing capability base](https://jubap.eu/reframing-value-creation/).
For a complementary reading, see [AICM: reframing the workforce as strategic capacity](https://jubap.eu/aicm-mexico-city-airport-transformation/).
La ampliación del marco orienta la búsqueda de capacidades ya disponibles.
El caso permite examinar cómo una intervención se apoya en capacidades y prácticas existentes.
